declined.subject: retry-backoff
declined.reason: The context ops-observability covers Sentry client-side exception capture and PII scrubbing (sentry-client.ts), read-only JSONL ops telemetry tail reading and local warning logging (ops-telemetry.ts), UI status-tone classification (status-tone.ts), and inbound request-level webhook deduplication (webhook-idempotency.ts). None of the context's files implement or configure outbound retry loops, backoff ladders, circuit breakers, durable retry tables, or retry error classification. Because the preconditions for the retry-backoff subject do not hold and not-applicable verdicts are not accepted from this seat, the pair is declined.
